# Signet7 — full guide for AI tools and agent developers

> Last aligned with signet7-web agent docs. Signet7 seals email; it does not encrypt it.

## MCP install and config

1. Install `signet7-mcp` from the Signet7 operator distribution (Windows: `Signet7-MCP.exe`). Public standalone install: PLACEHOLDER:signet7-mcp-install
2. Set environment:
   - `SIGNET7_MODE=production`
   - `SIGNET7_MCP_BASE_URL=https://verify.signet7.io` (use `https://api.signet7.io` after api-door cutover)
   - `SIGNET7_MCP_TENANT_ID` — tenant scope for remote mode
   - `SIGNET7_MCP_API_TOKEN` — inject via host secret store only
3. Cursor: add stdio server in `.cursor/mcp.json` with command `signet7-mcp`.
4. Claude Desktop: same command in `claude_desktop_config.json`.
5. Grok Bot and other MCP clients: stdio spawn of `signet7-mcp` with the same env keys.

Reference implementation and examples live in signet7-core `docs/apps/mcp/README.md` (not cloned on this site).

### Tools

| Tool (shipped) | Purpose |
|----------------|---------|
| `signet7_check_email` | Verify original `.eml` bytes (base64 in MCP). |
| `signet7_record_decision` | Record allow/refuse after verify when ledger row needed. |

Upcoming (parallel SDK): `signet7_verify_email`, `signet7_seal_email` — PLACEHOLDER until released.

## signet7.verify.v1

```json
{
  "schema": "signet7.verify.v1",
  "sealed": true,
  "verdict": "sealed",
  "signer": "treasury@example.com",
  "delegation": null,
  "receipt_id": "rcpt_example",
  "checked_at": "2026-11-15T12:00:00Z"
}
```

- `verdict=unsealed`: ordinary unsigned mail — refuse wire/autopay actions.
- `verdict=tampered`: wording changed after seal.
- `verdict=revoked`: signing key revoked.
- `verdict=unknown`: check failed or inconclusive — fail closed.
- `delegation`: `{ "agent_label", "principal" }` when delegated agent token signed — upcoming.

Media type placeholder: `application/vnd.signet7.verify.v1+json` (PLACEHOLDER:signet7.verify.v1-media-type).

## Device-code connect

1. `POST https://account.signet7.io/api/v1/account/device/start` with device metadata.
2. Human visits `verification_url` or account link page and approves.
3. Harness polls `POST …/device/poll` with `device_code`.
4. On success, `sender_token` stays in secure env — never in chat logs.

## Scenario: refuse unsealed wire

Inbox agent receives urgent wire instructions with no seal → verify → `verdict=unsealed` → agent refuses and escalates to human. Signet7 does not block payment rails; your code does.

## Limits

No encryption of message bodies. Not DMARC/SPF replacement. Not fraud scoring. Crisis language may trigger safety hold (see /safety). Caller enforces all decisions.
